title: Fire on the Forehead
translation: With the sparks of the fire blazing on the broad field of his forehead, he swallowed up Kama, the god of the five arrows. The leaders of the gods bow to him. His crest shines with the crescent of the nectar-rayed moon. May that matted-haired head of the great skull-bearer bring us prosperity.
translation_hi: जिन्होंने अपने ललाट रूपी आँगन में जलती अग्नि की चिंगारियों के तेज से पंचबाण कामदेव को भस्म कर दिया, जिन्हें देवताओं के नायक प्रणाम करते हैं, और जिनका मुकुट अमृतकिरण चंद्रमा की रेखा से शोभित है, उन महाकपाली शिव का जटाधारी मस्तक हमें समृद्धि दे।

words.note: The broad forehead seen as a square.
Literally 'winner of wealth'; also a name of Arjuna.
Root of भास्कर, 'light-maker', the sun, and Bhaskara's own name.
√nam. Hindi नमन. Becomes नमन् before न.
kapalin = one who carries a skull, Shiva.
Dative of sampad. Hindi संपदा, संपत्ति.

grammar: The story: this is Kamadahana. When Kama shot his arrows at Shiva, the fire of Shiva's third eye burned him to ash.
t → n before a nasal: नमत् + निलिम्प → नमन्निलिम्प.
अस्तु: the imperative of 'to be', used in blessings: स्वस्ति अस्तु, तथास्तु.
Bhaskara's name: भा (light) + कर (maker) = the sun. The author of the Lilavati carries this word in his name.
